title: Commission Statements
description: Quarterly commission statements where the plan itself is in formulas: attainment, base rate, accelerator above quota and SPIFFs, next to every deal behind them.
developerHook: Ship the compensation plan as auditable Excel formulas, typed against the rep schema.

preview.playgroundSummary: Twelve reps, their quota and closed-won, and a payout computed by Excel formulas: 8% to quota, 12% above it, plus SPIFFs. A deals sheet and a pivot by deal type sit behind it.
